summary: Crytek's Ryse is a Roman cinematic action game that launched with Xbox One and later received a PC release suited to high-fidelity capture.

entries.title: Ryse: Son of Rome

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build at documented graphics settings

primary.why: Ryse launched on Xbox One, but the later Windows release is the best capture/settings route and includes the single-player campaign with PC graphics options. Xbox One remains the launch-context route, especially for original achievements and controller feel.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC release. Record build, graphics settings, controller/keyboard state, difficulty, chapter, execution/QTE settings, collectible state, and whether Xbox One launch version or multiplayer/gladiator modes were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the higher-fidelity capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: High-fidelity PC route with graphics/settings flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is the higher-fidelity route; Xbox One preserves launch context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record graphics/build settings and whether multiplayer/service features are still accessible.
